I had already done bus 172 & 112
Personal review on Bus 172 & 112:
Bus 172 ( Introduction of Statistics)
Content is comparatively easy (partially similar with class 10 mathematics) but time management is the main challenge. All Faculty follow a fixed structured syllabus for this course.
On the other hand most of the bus 112 (Introduction to Business Mathematics) faculty doesn't follow any fixed syllabus ; most of them have their customized syllabus.
In my opinion: Bus 112 is harder than Bus 172; though I got a good grade in bus 112.
